versions.changelog: Refactored to focus on agent-driven scraping. Agent handles complex page nuances and asks clarifying questions. Added platform-specific install instructions for Claude, Cursor, and OpenClaw.

- Initial release of auto-scraping-to-csv.
- Scrape any webpage using text-based DOM manipulation via Playwright and Alibaba Page-Agent, controlled by Claude as the host model.
- No external LLM or OpenAI/Qwen API key required; only Node.js and Playwright.
- Export structured data to CSV using built-in workflows and convenient code snippets.
- Designed for data extraction, table scraping, UI verification, and automated workflow testing.
- Local setup instructions provided for bridge server and end-to-end usage.
